function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  

If you need the current time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, use a smartphone or computer clock set to the “America/New York” time zone, or run a quick command like:

```bash
TZ=America/New_York date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
```

That will give you the precise local time in New York.
